scope: First queued touch/guard/cancellation cohort plus preservation of its observations. This advances only the named OPEN Button G02 cell; it is not a complete replacement criterion inventory or a whole-cell closeout. Existing G01/G03/G05/G06 evidence, original tests and all failures remain unchanged.
preparationPolicy: Prioritize open/blocked cells; reuse existing public scene and original tests only. No passing-cell backfill or matrix promotion.

admission.source: Main verifies the full source/product/SDK/input tuple against the integration HEAD; scene SHA alone is insufficient.
admission.beforeEachMethod: Coordinator prepares the matched Release product in the foreground default Text/Button scene with primary actions0, longActions0, guards false, long callback absent, takeover none and empty trace, then obtains genuine current native receiver/window binding. Each XCTest method has its own admission; do not run this whole class against leftover state.
admission.nativeExecution: Use the existing Xcode UI-test target/standard only-testing selection under main's existing budget. No new native execution, device, build, process monitor or budget is authorized by this packet.
admission.originalWitness: The observer-manifest hash binds the instrument, not future runtime evidence. App WeakMap tokens are JS observation identities; rootTag comes from public findNodeHandle. Pair genuine SDK object/target/lifetime/window/cohort records and actual timing/cancellation after any normal activation and for every contact before adopting a native result.
admission.profile: Prepared iOS P01 normal portrait. Main validates actual text/window/device profile. Android and all other applicable profiles remain independently required.
admission.input: Original native touch only for this cohort; keyboard/virtual activation must not masquerade as touch. No JS event injection, second failed-action tap, pretyping warm-up or failure-path reset.

observationSchema.owner: library-button-behavior: actions, longActions, longPressEnabled, disabled, pending, pressStartTakeover, rootTag
observationSchema.trace: library-button-callbacks: complete ordered sequence/kind/receivedAt/data records. Event data snapshot preserves actual target, kind, timestamp, source, observedAt and observed JS/native object tokens. No event.persist or event mutation in the observer.
observationSchema.clocks: receivedAt is the JS callback-observation clock, not hardware input time. No hidden event truncation or fabricated native up/down.
observationSchema.eventOrdering: Keep original pointer partial orders and exact semantic/raw forwarding. The existing short-press-before-delayed-out oracle remains; do not impose the idle virtual activation order on all touch events.
